title: Research Bank
description: Stage 3 (Research Harvesting) output for a single function: research/<slug>.json. A bank of real, named, dated events with verifiable outcomes. Each record must clear the vetting gate before it is allowed to feed a spec. Presented (counts + sample) at CHECKPOINT 2 for human approval. Target: 10-12 vetted events per function so the spec can select the best 8-9.

function.description: Function slug this bank belongs to.

entity.description: Named company / CVE / agency — a proper noun. REQUIRED by the gate.

date.description: Event + outcome dates. Must contain a 4-digit year. REQUIRED by the gate.

outcome.description: A concrete outcome: number, ruling, settlement, or measurable result. Records without one are flagged weak.

verified.description: true once the record has passed the vetting gate (named entity + date + source).

weak.description: Set true when the record lacks a concrete outcome but otherwise passes.
